title: On Visiting the old nurse every week
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：visit　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 visit 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the observer ① visited the old nurse every week at once, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② visits the old nurse every week in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ visit the old nurse every week at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ visited the old nurse every week before — a line in the log for November 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Visiting the old nurse every week at once, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ visit the new school before opening in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Visit the new school before opening at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ visits the new school before opening at once every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ visited the old nurse every week again when nobody else would.

⑩ To visit the old nurse every week, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody visits the old nurse every week in the rain again and somebody must visit the old nurse every week at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 拜访（一般过去式 visited the old nurse every week：1953 年观测员头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 拜访（一般现在 visits the old nurse every week：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 拜访（不定式 to visit the old nurse every week：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 拜访（过去完成时 had visited the old nurse every week：1947 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 拜访（动名词 visiting the old nurse every week 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 参观（visit the new school before opening：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去参观开学前去参观了新学堂）
G. v. 参观（visit the new school before opening：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 拜访（后段两处：新来的助手照例 visits the new school before opening，而母亲又一次 visited the old nurse every week）

answers.why: visit 意为“拜访”，1953 年观测员二话不说地拜访每周去看那位老乳母，那是观测站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 visited。
visit 意为“拜访”，自那以后观测员淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 visits。
visit 意为“拜访”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯拜访每周去看那位老乳母”，此处为不定式 to visit the old nurse every week。
visit 意为“拜访”，观测记录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人拜访过，故用过去完成时 had visited。
visit 意为“拜访”，观测员说“拜访每周去看那位老乳母这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 visiting the old nurse every week 作主语。
visit 意为“参观”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去参观开学前去参观了新学堂”，should ever 之后用原形 visit the new school before opening。
visit 意为“参观”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻参观开学前去参观了新学堂（visit the new school before opening at once），以后再也不要提起。
visit 意为“拜访”，新来的助手每个夜晚都照例参观开学前去参观了新学堂，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 visits。
visit 意为“拜访”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地拜访每周去看那位老乳母，用一般过去式 visited 叙述。
visit 意为“拜访”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要拜访每周去看那位老乳母，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和观测站记住的那一件。

items: 1953 年，观测员二话不说地拜访每周去看那位老乳母；观测站里每一个助手都说这是头一回。（visited the old nurse every week）
多年以后，观测员仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（visits the old nurse every week）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯拜访每周去看那位老乳母这件事本身。（to visit the old nurse every week）
早在 1947 年就有人拜访每周去看那位老乳母，十一月那天观测记录上的一行字就是证据。（had visited the old nurse every week）
观测员说过，二话不说地拜访每周去看那位老乳母这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（visiting the old nurse every week 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻参观开学前去参观了新学堂，以后再也不要提起。（visit the new school before opening，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 visit 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the observer visited the old nurse every week at once, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer visits the old nurse every week in the rain whenever the observatory asks.
Visiting the old nurse every week at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever visit the new school before opening in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory visits the new school before opening at once every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother visited the old nurse every week again, and the observatory remembered that half.
